title: How do you guys market your games developed using AI assistance?
author: yapdakilla81
selftext: Since majority of Reddit and Discord channels are blocking games with gen AI usage?

comments.author: Charming_You_25
comments.body: What are they blocking? Gen image usage? Or any game programmed with an ai?

replies.author: yapdakilla81
replies.body: Basically anything that has AI disclosure on Steam, even if asking for feedback on how to improve.

replies.author: Epyx911
replies.body: There are plenty of AI disclosed games doing well on Steam. I wouldn't worry just make a good game.

replies.author: Kindly_Life_947
replies.body: yea I was looking at some research. 3 years study. The AI generated games only rated few points lower than real games if the prices was cheaper. I beat those negative reviews and lost sales came from the indie devs. Lesson they wont buy your game but they are minority.

comments.author: Koufaxisking
comments.body: Odd considering about 90% of my reddit ads atp are ai developed games heavily derivative of one of 3 games in the roguelite genre. “THIS but if it were THIS.”

replies.author: yapdakilla81
replies.body: So best way is just to pay for Reddit ads?

comments.author: False-Car-1218
comments.body: Coding with AI assistance is fine, the probably is AI generated assets is very easy to spot and they look uncanny like those very high fidelity pixel art

comments.author: yapdakilla81
comments.body: Maybe I should just focus on releasing demos on Steam collecting feedback and farming wishlists instead of discord or Reddit

comments.author: RuinousFate
comments.body: Do discords block that? What discords are you on

replies.author: yapdakilla81
replies.body:
Indie games, indie game Joe.

Mods just close discussion topic for games looking for feedback done using AI assistance.

comments.author: Officialpolygrafix
comments.body: I have my hermes agent do a tweet twice a week on my behalf for one of my games. It gets a little attention but not much. X allows it, so long as it doesn't go against their rules, (no dm outreach, etc.)

comments.author: angry_cactus
comments.body: If you put enough work into your game to give it a cohesive playstyle, cohesive art style, and it looks like a polished finished game, then it doesn't really matter what techniques you used to develop it, as long as you are respecting licenses. Remember to promote your game to players, not just other devs.

replies.author: moonblade89
replies.body: This. Half these people don’t know what the fuck they’re talking about when it comes to AI, its just a trend to hate on AI. Put out something that doesnt look like slop and plays well and they wont be able to tell the difference

replies.author: moonblade89
replies.body: How does what I said contradict that? I’m not saying dont disclose it. Im saying release a good AI game thats indistinguishable from a “non AI” game

replies.author: blandvanilla
replies.body: I'm not fighting, champ. I'm saying it could hurt your game if you disclose ai use because there are people who wouldn't even want to try your game once they see that disclosure.

replies.author: NotaDevAI
replies.body: 'Remember to promote your game to players, not just other devs.' That's the core part I believe. Once you use AI and try to introduce to other devs(who are the most people on relevant communities), they just look at you with prejudice and hatred. As long as your game is built well, well designed, most actual user wouldn't care if you used AI or not.

comments.author: Destituted
comments.body:
Don't market to other game devs and Indie Game subs, they're mostly developers themselves.

I saw an AI game get posted in the World of Warcraft sub this morning and no one said anything about AI, they all were very interested in it.  The post is probably deleted by mods by now, but no one noticed or cared.

Other game devs and the whole Indie Game community are mostly out to kill AI game dev, but it doesn't matter.

I released a game a few years ago with very bad AI assets looking back on it, 10s of thousands of downloads and 100s of reviews, not one mention of AI from anyone.

comments.author: Neon_Moon_NZ
comments.body: Order a steak then dump a glass of water all over it

comments.author: superkickstart
comments.body: Create a game and market that. Do not try to market a ai generated incomplete prototypes.
